$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F06 GCD detail (A6): the right temple at the hinge from the front right, framed 4:5 on the hinge; the temples run off the left edge. The far temple touches the near one's lit top face in the picture, so the near temple's edges were measured by hand (temple_gcd.py --edges). The engraved wordmark and the old emblem come off; the GCD is placed with the old print as a ruler (its ends 26.3 and 41.4 mm from the hinge, from the 3D model on the hero, IMG_3483). The shield is seen at a steep angle and kept as photographed (lens_cleanup.as_shot): measured against the tent it came out lighter than the frame round it, with a ragged step where SAM's mask stopped inside the lens's lower corner. The thin dark line where the shield turns along its lower inner edge is its own, not dust (lens_cleanup.keep): cleaned as dust, it was mostly lost.

lenses.name: shield lens, near half and its far half past the nose arch

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges)
